panel.title: AI Assistant
panel.getStarted: Start a new conversation to get insights about your business

chat.welcome: Hello! I'm your AI Business Assistant
chat.welcomeMessage: I can help you analyze your sales, inventory, customers, and more. Ask me anything about your business data!
chat.placeholder: Ask me anything about your business...
chat.hint: Press Enter to send, Shift+Enter for new line

roleWelcome.general: Hello! I'm your General Business Assistant. I can help you with any aspect of your business - sales, inventory, accounting, HR, and more. What would you like to know?
roleWelcome.marketing: Welcome! I'm your Marketing Consultant. I specialize in analyzing sales trends, customer behavior, and growth opportunities. Ready to discover insights that can boost your revenue?
roleWelcome.legal: Greetings! I'm your Legal Compliance Advisor. I can help with compliance checks, documentation standards, and audit trails. Note: I don't provide legal advice - please consult a licensed attorney for legal matters. How can I assist with compliance today?
roleWelcome.customer_service: Hi there! I'm your Customer Service Assistant. I'm here to help you quickly find order status, customer information, and inventory availability. What customer inquiry can I help with?
roleWelcome.financial_analyst: Hello! I'm your Financial Analyst. I specialize in KPIs, profitability analysis, cash flow insights, and financial forecasting. Let's dive into the numbers - what would you like to analyze?

roles.label: Assistant Mode
roles.general_help: Get comprehensive answers about your entire business
roles.marketing_help: Focus on sales analysis, customer behavior, and growth strategies
roles.legal_help: Get guidance on compliance, contracts, and record-keeping (not legal advice)
roles.customer_service_help: Help with customer inquiries, orders, and support tasks
roles.financial_analyst_help: Deep dive into financials, KPIs, and profitability analysis
